'''Carly Robins''' is a voice actress for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Robins is an American voice actress. She joined {{aniseries|PTS}} during [[M19|the nineteenth movie]], where she voiced [[Kimia]]. She gained her most notable during {{aniseries|SM}}, where she voiced [[Wicke]]. Prior to {{aniseries|JN}}, she was credited as '''Riley Joseph'''.
